title: eriogonum baileyi var. davidsonii
intro: Eriogonum baileyi var. davidsonii, commonly known as Davidson's buckwheat or Davidson's sagebrush-mallow, is a flowering plant in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support the immune system and is believed to have anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum baileyi var. davidsonii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
